paper_title: Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables
caption: The macro f-score of GAIT_{GAT} and RECA on Semtab dataset, for High, Medium, and Low-frequency classes.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the macro f-scores of two models, RECA and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub>, across three frequency classes: High, Medium, and Low. The horizontal axis displays the frequency categories, ordered as High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, and labeled "Macro f-score". Tick labels are displayed at 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1. Two sets of bars are presented, one for RECA and one for GAIT<sub>GAT</sub>, differentiated by color: RECA is represented by orange bars and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> by reddish-brown bars. The bar representing RECA for the High frequency class has an approximate value of 0.877, while for the Low frequency class, it has an approximate value of 0.114.  The GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar for the High frequency class has an approximate value of 0.837, and for the Low frequency class, it has an approximate value of 0.09. The bars are not sorted by any explicit order, and none are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation.
